title: Training Notes on Whole Life Insurance: From When an Automatic Premium Loan Bears Interest at Anniversary Capitalization
content:
**Rule.** Within an anniversary capitalization on an Ashgrove Whole Life Insurance policy, the latest automatic premium loan on the policy ledger, where it was booked after the start of the interest period and on or before the anniversary, is set apart from the rest of the principal:

- on a policy paying by **monthly EFT draft**, it bears interest from the **due date of the draft it paid**, because an automatic premium loan is dated back to the installment it pays;
- on a policy billed on **any other mode**, it bears interest from **the date it was booked**, the last day of grace;
- where the latest automatic premium loan does not fall inside the interest period, nothing is set apart for it.

**Which automatic premium loan is considered?** Only the latest automatic premium loan advance on the ledger, judged by its booking date.

**How is "inside the interest period" judged?** By the booking date: after the period start and on or before the anniversary. On a monthly EFT policy the due date of the draft decides only from when it bears interest, not whether it is inside the period.

**Which records are read?** The automatic premium loan advance entry (its booking date, the installment due date it paid and its amount) and the premium mode on the policy record.

**What about the rest of the principal?** The ledger principal less the automatic premium loan set apart bears interest from the start of the interest period.

**Worked cases (hypothetical, period starting September 1, 2024, anniversary September 1, 2025).**

| Premium mode | Draft or installment due | Automatic premium loan booked | Bears interest from |
|---|---|---|---|
| Monthly EFT draft | March 5, 2025 | April 7, 2025 | March 5, 2025 |
| Quarterly | March 5, 2025 | April 5, 2025 (last day of grace) | April 5, 2025 |
| Monthly EFT draft | August 5, 2024 | September 5, 2024 | August 5, 2024 |
| Annual | August 20, 2024 | August 31, 2024 | Nothing set apart: booked before the period start |
